scope: Backwards-compatible pinned native identity authority records; no production client switch or migration

record_format.clientID: Must exactly match registry authority; no native secret
record_format.preserved: Existing userID stable local binding, tokens, PKCE state/verifier/createdAt/expectedUser

legacy_policy: Untagged old records pin to immutable legacy Vipi Production, with existing explicitly staging-configured debug builds retaining legacy staging. Never infer old record authority from a future production default. Partial tags, unknown realm/client and future versions fail closed.

operations.fresh_sign_in: Configured public client must resolve to reviewed registry
operations.reauth: Saved authority wins over default build client; expected old user with no session retains legacy authority
operations.callback: Saved pending authority chooses exact original PKCE client; current authority+subject must both match before replacing existing session
operations.refresh: Saved session authority chooses original client and is preserved on token rotation

native_macos_swift_foundation.source: Exact Foundation formats/helpers from Authentication.swift plus actual focused XCTest tests, only test module import renamed

local_kotlin_jvm.source: Exact IdentityAuthority enum and actual IdentityAuthorityDeviceTest class, isolated BuildConfig fixture DEBUGfalse with unknown future default

checks.instrumentation: Delivered additional actual Authentication refresh/callback exchange test with synthetic qualificationExchange; not run, no network/emulator/phone interaction

limitations: Shared application authority not registered until actual client exists and is reviewed
No migration activation until server dual-proof linking contract exists
No network/provider sign-in or token exchange performed by these serialization tests
